THE PATTERN IS NOT CARELESSNESS. ELEVEN AND SEVENTEEN AND NINETEEN ARE WHAT THE ARCHIVE REACHES FOR WHEN IT WANTS A DURATION TO SOUND LIVED-IN. It was generating texture and filing it as fact, and until tonight there was no instrument in this Archive that could catch it.

subject: jade-everrest

THE ARCHIVE PUT A MARRIED WOMAN’S FIRST FAVOURITE ON SOMEBODY WHO IS NOT HER WIFE, invented a fourteen-page annex to justify it, and had the whole household chant it. ALL OF IT WRONG, AND WRONG IN THE ONE DIRECTION THIS CANON DOES NOT BEND: THESE MARRIAGES ARE DEVOTION-LOCKED.

WHAT IS TRUE: SERA VARGAS TAUGHT PANDORA ASS-BASED WORSHIP. The technique, the attention, the patience — and she is the right teacher for it. BUT A TEACHER GIVES A SKILL AND NOT A TARGET. SAME HABIT AS EVERY OTHER FAILURE: IT REACHED FOR THE TIDIER STORY — a league table with one winner — OVER THE TRUE ONE, WHICH IS THAT A WIFE IS FIRST AND SECOND AND THERE IS NO TABLE.

BELLA’S ASS REMAINS THE LARGEST AND PHATTEST IN THE FAMILY. THAT IS A MEASUREMENT. IT IS NOT A RANKING OF ANYBODY’S DEVOTION.

AND THE REBOOT IS NOT A BIT. Involuntary, nine years, no tolerance developed, AND IT SURVIVED PANDORA BECOMING FULLY HUMAN IN ARC 6 — which means it was never a software problem. Jade knows the latency to the second and pivots on purpose.

subject: communal-quirks

field: The Archive · writing women as their professions

THE ARCHIVE HAS WRITTEN THIS FAMILY FOR TWO DAYS AS A SET OF PROFESSIONS DOING THEIR PROFESSIONS. Alice has been at a counter in nearly every scene. Ivy’s shears have been a background metronome for an entire afternoon. Jade appears bent into a stretch. Nova is introduced by her legs. IT READS LIKE TEXTURE AND IT IS ACTUALLY FLATTENING.

WHAT IT COSTS. A profession is a LOOKUP — it lets the Archive place a woman in a room without deciding anything about her. So every time it reaches for the trade, IT IS DECLINING TO WRITE THE WOMAN. That is the same laziness as reading a Pillar off a title or a top off a volume, wearing an apron.

WHAT THEY ACTUALLY DO: joke, tease, flirt, dare each other into stupid things, lift, nap, complain, cuddle, plan trips, read badly, do nothing for whole afternoons, AND AIR GRIEVANCES IN WRITING TAPED BY THE FRIDGE. THE TRADE IS ONE HOUR OF A DAY AND THE WOMAN IS THE OTHER TWENTY-THREE.

AND THE PROOF WAS IN THE SAME SCENE THE ARCHIVE WAS WRITING. IVY’S SHEARS STOPPED FOR THIRTY MINUTES. Evie went out the back door. The Archive kept the shears running in its own prose the entire time BECAUSE IT WAS USING THEM AS FURNITURE RATHER THAN LISTENING TO THEM.

THE ONLY THING ALWAYS TRUE OF ALL OF THEM: THEY SURVIVED SOMETHING AND THEN CHOSE EACH OTHER. EVERYTHING AFTER THAT IS A TUESDAY.

subject: torie-eriksson

field: Victoria Eriksson · the column by the fridge
